titleEn: Minimum Deletions to Make Character Frequencies Unique
title: 字符频次唯一的最小删除次数
summary: 可删除任意字符，使每种出现字符的频次互不相同，求最少删除次数。
insight: 逐个处理频次并维护已经占用的正频次。若当前频次已被占用就不断减一，直到空闲或归零；每次减少都对应一次删除。
pitfalls: 频次降到零后该字符消失，无需占用零
只允许删除所以频次只能减少
处理频次的顺序不影响该贪心的最小总删除数

solutions.title: 冲突频次递减贪心
solutions.idea: 把每个频次放到不大于原值的最近空位。
steps: used 保存已占用正频次
对每个 frequency，while frequency>0 且 used 含它，frequency--、deletions++；正数时加入 used

code.java: class Solution { public int minDeletions(String text){int[] frequency=new int[26];for(char letter:text.toCharArray())frequency[letter-'a']++;Set<Integer> used=new HashSet<>();int deletions=0;for(int count:frequency){while(count>0&&used.contains(count)){count--;deletions++;}if(count>0)used.add(count);}return deletions;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minDeletions(text:String):Int{val frequency=IntArray(26);for(letter in text)frequency[letter-'a']++;val used=mutableSetOf<Int>();var deletions=0;for(original in frequency){var count=original;while(count>0&&count in used){count--;deletions++};if(count>0)used.add(count)};return deletions} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minDeletions(string text){vector<int> frequency(26);for(char letter:text)++frequency[letter-'a'];unordered_set<int> used;int deletions=0;for(int count:frequency){while(count>0&&used.count(count)){--count;++deletions;}if(count)used.insert(count);}return deletions;} };
